fields.title: Ground contact, inventory and heaviness conventions
fields.finding: The trajectory assumes a neutral full sphere at 500 m with non-air mass 4889.444 kg, rather than proving the built 028b/022d inventory. Centre altitude zero is also ten metres below first contact for an R10 sphere. About 5131 kg is incoming gas, not the net buoyancy deficit.
fields.proposed_fix: Specify carried inventory, sagged displacement and initial restraint; stop at centre height 10 m above terrain. For the same gross reference, torn-bay first-contact speeds remain 23.099647–34.541863 m/s and net heaviness about 4889 kg.
